hero.title: ABOUT ME
hero.subtitle: Get to know more about my background, skills, and passions

intro.name: Adrián Ortiz Ramírez
intro.p1: Hi there! I’m Adrián and I’m currently working as an AI engineer. Lately, I’ve been focused on bringing Speech Emotion Recognition, AI Compliance Evaluation and Psychology AI into the real world.
intro.p2: I love making things look simple.

skills.title: AI & ML
skills.items: Deep learning, Speech analysis, RAG, Multi-agent systems, Model evaluation, Fine-tuning, Prompt engineering

summaries.cephalgo: Leading the development and training of deep-learning speech models, with clinical partners, to detect early vocal signs of Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s disease. Previously built a RAG system and led an international team on multi-agent AI analysis and compliance.
summaries.nttdata: Built RAG pipelines with OCR and structured extraction to turn large collections of technical documents for energy companies into reliable, grounded answers. Ran internal sessions on prompt engineering.
summaries.mentor: Mentored young adults with intellectual disabilities in the digital skills needed for web accessibility review.
summaries.bachelor: Four-year degree with a foundation in algorithms, mathematics, databases, networks, operating systems, software engineering and AI.
summaries.cybersecurityDiploma: Specialisation in ethical hacking and pentesting, digital forensics, secure development with OWASP, and web, mobile and IoT security.
summaries.journalPublication: “Object Recognition and Conversational AI in Real-World Contexts”, Street Art & Urban Creativity, vol. 11, pp. 21–47. Derived from my Bachelor’s thesis.
summaries.articlePresentation: Presented my work on object recognition and conversational AI for museums at Smart City Expo World Congress 2025, Fira Barcelona Gran Via.
summaries.cisti: Co-authored and presented ALPACA, a mobile app against household food waste, at the 19th Iberian Conference on Information Systems and Technologies (University of Salamanca).
summaries.excellence: Among the top five students of the cohort in the 2023/2024 academic year, recognised by the degree leadership.
summaries.hackforgood: Prize-winning project at the Madrid edition of Spain’s largest hackathon, at Telefónica’s 42 Madrid campus: an app to support people before and during meteorological disasters.
summaries.adabyron: Represented UFV with team ByteHunters at the 10th Madrid edition of the Ada Byron University Programming Contest (uc3m).
